prompt: Add a validator that checks if parsed tokens list is empty before processing starts and raises a descriptive exception.

assertions.name: plan_file_created
assertions.description: A plan markdown file was written to docs/plans/

assertions.name: has_two_or_more_approaches
assertions.description: The plan contains at least 2 explored approaches with pros/cons

assertions.name: tasks_have_exact_file_paths
assertions.description: Every implementation task lists exact file paths (no vague references like 'the service file')

assertions.name: tasks_have_test_cases_with_markers
assertions.description: Implementation tasks include test cases marked with ✅ or ❌

assertions.name: tasks_have_code_not_descriptions
assertions.description: Tasks contain actual code (class names, method signatures, or code blocks) not just prose descriptions

assertions.name: single_explorer_agent_for_simple_scope
assertions.description: Only 1 explorer agent was dispatched (simple scope → 1 agent)

assertions.name: tdd_skill_referenced
assertions.description: Every implementation task ends with a reference to /test-driven-development skill
